passages.scripture: And this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it and testified to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.

lines.text: And this is the life: Jesus.
The life was revealed.
The life is the eternal life.
The eternal life was with the Father.
The eternal life was revealed to us witnesses.
We have seen the eternal life.
We testified to the eternal life.
We proclaim the eternal life to you.

passages.scripture: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands—this is the Word of life.

lines.text: The Word of life, the Word, was from the beginning of all things.
The Word is Jesus.
Jesus is the Life.
Before the world was made, the Word was there eternally.
We are witnesses of the Word.
We have heard the Word.
We have seen the Word with our own eyes.
We have gazed upon the Word.
And we have touched the Word with our own hands.
And so the Word came to us in a real body.

passages.scripture: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.

lines.text: We witnesses have seen and heard Jesus.
We proclaim Jesus to you.
We proclaim so that you also may have fellowship with us.
And this fellowship of ours is with the Father.
And this fellowship is with His Son, Jesus Christ.

passages.scripture: We write these things so that our joy may be complete.

lines.text: We witnesses write these things.
We write so that our joy may be complete.

passages.scripture: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.

lines.text: We witnesses heard the message from Jesus.
We announce the message to you.
And this is the message: God is light.
And in God there is no darkness at all.

passages.scripture: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.

lines.text: Suppose we say we have fellowship with God.
But suppose we walk in the darkness.
Then we lie.
And we do not practice the truth.

passages.scripture: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.

lines.text: God is in the light.
Suppose we walk in the light, as God is.
Then we have fellowship with one another.
And the blood of Jesus cleanses us from all sin.
Jesus is God's Son.

passages.scripture: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

lines.text: Suppose we say we have no sin.
Then we deceive ourselves.
And the truth is not in us.

passages.scripture: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

lines.text: God is faithful.
God is just.
Suppose we confess our sins.
Then God forgives us our sins.
And God cleanses us from all unrighteousness.

passages.scripture: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.

lines.text: Suppose we say we have not sinned.
Then we make God a liar.
And God's word is not in us.
